description: A project's calendar PAUSES and DAYS OFF that end on 'since' or later: kind 'pause' (chosen series switched off for a period — 'events' it names and/or every event with 'label') or 'dayoff' (a holiday: no occurrence of a REPEATING event lands on it; an event that happens once stays). 'from'/'to' are days, inclusive, each read on the occurrence's own event's clock. The occurrences they take show in list_calendar_events with withCancelled as cancelled with 'pause'. Any member may read.
name: list_calendar_pauses
title: List calendar pauses
